personality: 7 Dark-First Utility structure with 6 Glass / Luxe vivid gradient surfaces
personality_one_liner: A high-performance, dark-mode command center infused with cinematic lighting, glowing navy gradients, and vibrant orange accents to feel premium and alive.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around structural containers, tight spacing inside data groups. Ensure minimum 56pt height for list rows. Do not leave trailing empty space in grids.

do's: Apply glass effects to the bottom tab bar.
Use blur layers on sticky headers over scrolling content.
Use vivid expo-linear-gradient overlays paired with expo-blur on featured hero cards (e.g. Account Balance).
dont's: Do not apply glass to dense list items or form inputs.
Do not blur background text to the point of muddying the screen.
Do not use generic unstyled Alert or Modals.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: A commanding overview of account health, equity curve, and recent performance metrics.

states.loading: Centered brand-colored spinner with skeleton shapes for the chart and stat cards.
states.empty: No trades yet. Shows an abstract glowing chart illustration with a prominent 'Log First Trade' CTA.
states.error: Failed to load data. Readable error text with a retry button.

screens.layout: Use a large Hero Card at the top displaying Account Balance and a line chart. The Hero Card should use 'dashboard_texture' as a background image overlaid with a heavy vertical linear gradient scrim (transparent to #0D1117 at bottom). Below it, place the 'Weekly Recap' card and a 2-column grid for 'Win Rate', 'Profit Factor', etc. Add a floating 'Add Trade' FAB in #FF7F00 (brandTertiary) positioned above the bottom tab bar.

screens.name: Trade Journal
screens.purpose: A scannable, filterable list of all executed and missed trades.

states.empty: Empty state illustration of a notebook/journal, instructing user to log a trade.
states.error: Error fetching trades with a retry CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky header containing segmented controls (Executed vs Missed) and horizontal scrollable 'Grade A-F' filter chips. Trade list cards have symbol in Rajdhani, P&L highlighted in success/error colors, and a left-aligned border strip indicating win (green) or loss (red).

screens.name: Trade Detail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific trade with screenshot analysis and AI coaching insights.

states.loading: Skeleton for hero image and metric grid.
states.empty: N/A - Screen only accessed via a valid trade.

screens.layout: Top 30% is a full-bleed Hero screenshot image with a MANDATORY gradient scrim (transparent to #0D1117) anchoring the P&L and Symbol text. Below, display a metrics grid (Entry, Exit, Qty). The 'AI Coach Insight' card should feature a subtle #1E5FBF (navy) outer glow or border to distinguish it as an AI generation.

screens.name: AI Coach
screens.purpose: An interactive chat interface for users to ask about their trading habits and rules.

states.empty: Welcome message with suggested prompt chips.
states.error: Failed to send message, tap to retry.

screens.layout: Standard chat interface. User messages use surfaceTertiary background. AI messages use a subtle #0A4DA0 gradient background. Place actionable follow-up prompt chips horizontally above the input field.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User settings, subscription tier status, and referral rewards.
screens.layout: Display a prominent Subscription Tier badge at the top. If Premium, give the badge a vibrant #FF7F00 glowing gradient background. Follow with standard list rows for settings, billing, and referral code.

dashboard_texture.alt: Dark geometric textured background for dashboard hero

hero_background.alt: Abstract dark navy glowing waves background

instructions_to_main_agent: Vivid Glowing Cards: To 'spruce it up', wrap key statistic cards and the AI Coach card in a view with a 1px borderStrong (#1E5FBF or #FF7F00) and apply a subtle shadow, OR use an expo-linear-gradient as the card's background (e.g. fading from #1E5FBF at 20% opacity to transparent).

Dashboard Backgrounds: Implement the 'dashboard_texture' image as the background for the main Account Balance / Equity hero card. You MUST layer a vertical expo-linear-gradient scrim over it to ensure text readability.

Typography Hierarchy: Use Rajdhani for all numeric data (Account balances, P&L, stats, grades) and large display headings. Use DM Sans for all body text, labels, and AI chat bubbles. Keep font weights at 400 or 500 max.
Tab Bar and Overlays: Apply glassmorphism (expo-blur) to the bottom tab bar. Use the vibrant orange (#FF7F00) for the active tab icon/indicator to make it pop against the dark theme.

Color Usage: Do not use pure #121212 or #000000 for backgrounds; stick to the provided #0D1117 (dark slate/navy). Use #FF7F00 exclusively for primary calls to action (FAB, Premium badges) to draw the eye.
